{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Confirm the 6 QA orders with 999999.99
qa_orders = df[df['revenue'] == '999999.99']
print(f"Number of QA orders: {len(qa_orders)}")
print("Sample of QA orders:")
print(qa_orders[['order_id', 'channel', 'customer_segment', 'revenue']])

# Remove the 6 QA orders
df_clean = df[df['revenue'] != '999999.99'].copy()
print(f"\nNew dataset shape after removing QA orders: {df_clean.shape}")

# Now parse revenue as float, removing commas if any
# Although only 6 had commas, and they're gone, still strip and cast
# But since they're already gone, just cast the remaining
# Ensure no other commas are present
assert not df_clean['revenue'].str.contains(',', na=False).any(), "Unexpected commas in revenue after removing QA orders"

# Safe to cast to float
df_clean['revenue'] = df_clean['revenue'].astype(float)

# Verify
print(f"\nFirst 5 revenue values after parsing:")
print(df_clean['revenue'].head(5))"}
